items.description: Signed QB Andy Dalton. Released QB Cooper Rush.
Signed DB K.C. Eziomume to the practice squad.
Placed TE Tanner Hudson on injured reserve.
Signed WR DeAndre Carter to the practice squad.
Fired general manager Chris Ballard.
Signed T Amari Kight and T Darian Kinnard to the practice squad. Released G Evan Neal and TE Chris Myarick from the practice squad.
Placed K Blake Grupe on injured reserve.
Designated RB Jordan Mason to return from injured reserve.

Placed WR Romeo Doubs on injured reserve. Signed DB Elliott Davison from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed WR Ryan Miller, OL Jacob Rizy and G Andrew Rupcich to the practice squad. Released CB D'Shawn Jamison from the practice squad.
Elevated LB Jalen Graham and WR Malik Turner from the practice squad to the active roster. Released G Brett Toth from injured reserve with an injury settlement.
Signed FB Jackson Acker and TE Josiah Deguara to the practice squad. Released RB Dontae McMillan and WR Malick Meiga from the practice squad.

Reinstated CB Trey Amos, LB Jordan Magee and RB Jeremy McNichols from injured reserve. Elevated LB T.J. Maguranyanga from the practice squad to the active roster. Placed RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt and LB Javontae Jean-Baptiste on injured reserve. Waived LB Austin Keys.
Signed OLB Bralen Trice to the active roster. Signed S Jammie Robinson to the practice squad.
Activated CB Kyler Gordon from the PUP list. Signed DB Nick McCloud to the active roster. Placed DL Dayo Odeyingbo on injured reserve. Waived DB Xavier Woods.
Activated WR Savion Williams off injured reserve. Placed DTs Jonathan Ford, Javon Hargrave and WR Skyy Moore on injured reserve.
Activated CB Joshua Williams from injured reserve. Waived DB Erick Hallett.
Activated TE Will Mallory from injured reserve.
Activated OT Keagen Trost.
Activated WR A.J. Brown. Released RB Hassan Haskins from the practice squad.
Activated S Zach wood.
Activated WR Omar Cooper Jr. from injured reserve.
Activated S Kitan Crawford from injured reserve.
Placed WR Roman Wilson on injured reserve. Signed RB Lew Nichols to the active roster.
Activated WR KeAndre Lambert-Smith from injured reserve. Released WR Marquez Valdes-Scantling. Signed OLB Caleb Murphy to the active roster.
Activated WR Ja'Kobi Lane from injured reserve. Signed LB Carl Jones from the practice squad.
